channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Anganwadi Cook Dies Saving 20 Children From Bee Attack in Madhya Pradesh Village
item.description: A Madhya Pradesh Anganwadi cook died after shielding 20 children from a fatal bee swarm attack.

item.title: Delhi Man Loses ₹4 Lakh After Clicking Fake ₹1,000 Traffic Challan Link on WhatsApp
item.description: A fraudulent WhatsApp message posing as an official traffic challan led to unauthorised transactions worth over ₹4 lakh, prompting police warnings about rising cyber scams.

item.title: ‘Please Protect Democracy’: Mamata Banerjee Challenges ECI in Supreme Court, Argues Her Own Case
item.description: Mamata Banerjee argued in person at the Supreme Court, alleging 58 lakh voters were wrongly deleted in Bengal.

item.title: Navi Mumbai Tragedy: 35-Year-Old Man Allegedly Dies by Suicide in New Panvel Amid Suspected Legal, Family Dispute Stress, Probe On
item.description: A 35-year-old man’s suicide in Panvel amid marital litigation has reignited concerns over legal stress and mental health support.

item.title: CCTV Captures Gas-Filled Balloons Explosion Inside Goregaon Residential Lift Prompting Police Probe in Mumbai
item.description: A cluster of gas-filled balloons exploded inside a Goregaon residential elevator, injuring two people and prompting a police negligence probe.

item.title: Mumbai Enforces Strict Cleanliness Rules With Fines Up To ₹25,000 To Improve Public Hygiene
item.description: Mumbai’s civic body has introduced new bylaws imposing fines from ₹200 to ₹25,000 to curb littering, spitting, illegal dumping, and other cleanliness violations.

item.title: Govt Partners With Physics Wallah to Provide Free Competitive Exams Coaching for Disadvantaged Students
item.description: The government partners with Physics Wallah to provide free competitive exam coaching for 5,000 disadvantaged students.

item.title: Bengaluru Metro Rides Set to Get Costlier Again; Fares Likely to Rise 5% From Feb 9
item.description: Bengaluru's Namma Metro implements a fresh five per cent fare hike, increasing daily costs for millions of commuters.

item.title: Overturned Gas Tanker Triggers 30-Hour Shutdown on Busy Mumbai-Pune Expressway, Thousands Stranded
item.description: A tanker carrying flammable gas overturned in the Khandala Ghat section, paralysing the Mumbai-Pune Expressway for over 30 hours and leaving thousands of commuters stranded.

item.title: Fact Check: Fake Emails Claiming E-PAN Download Circulate; Government Issues Clarification
item.description: The government has warned about a phishing scam using fake emails to steal E-PAN details.
